missing_source_rule: Keep the planned sample unavailable; do not replace it with another time.
annotation_rule: Review raw center frames and adjacent context without prediction overlays. Record visible equipment or movement evidence, not model labels or net position alone. Keep uncertain or occluded roles explicit.
annotation_scope: Visible people around the nearer net in each center frame. References do not enumerate every person or establish absent players.
reference_geometry: A manually selected image point and review crop identify the visible subject. Neither is a full-body ground-truth bounding box or a track.
known_review_overlap_rule: Record overlap with prior source samples and dense diagnostic cache intervals. Do not move overlapping samples or claim they are unseen.
separation: Role references remain separate from outcome keys and generated predictions. No role rule or model changes are permitted during intake.
limits: All five games have prior outcome evaluation; this is not a held-out game partition.
A reserved evaluation partition has no role-rule fitting during this intake. It is not proof that nobody previously viewed the footage.
Two candidate-selected times per game do not measure whole-game role accuracy, camera safety, or precision.
Nominal sample bins are not exact frame timestamps or verified total sync accuracy.
Still frames and short context do not establish goal outcomes, Play Types, or exact camera handovers.
